headline: Recommended final passage of Ordinance O-26-019, incorporating the Environmental Health Department subdivision review fee with other subdivision plan review fees, 4-0.
summary: A public hearing on Ordinance O-26-019 had no testimony. Members voted 4-0 to recommend final passage of the ordinance. A presentation on parking and mobility management was also held.
decisions: Accepted the Planning Manager's referral communication on Ordinance O-26-019 and placed it on file.
Recommended final passage of Ordinance O-26-019 by roll call vote, 4-0.

PLANNING AND ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMITTEE 
 
JULY 21, 2026

Aldermanic Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of 
RSA 91-A:2 II. 
 
The roll call was taken with 4 members of the Planning and Economic Development Committee present:
